Name: Woolly Duckbear Barn Animal
Author: Campaigner
Description:
==================
WHAT IS THIS?
==================
Say hello to the Woolly Duckbear, my unusual take on what was originally supposed to be a hybrid between a duck and a pig, but quickly spiraled out of control into this big lovable thing. Partially inspired by the Sniffer from Minecraft, this big creature lumbers around your barn, laying an egg every day, and its eggs can be used for making a vibrant red mayonnaise, a spicy curry, or some delicious red pudding, the recipies for the latter two being sold by Gus at the Saloon.

Adopt one at Marnie's Ranch today!


==================
REQUIRED MODS
==================
"Content Patcher" by Pathoschild
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/url]
- Required


==================
KNOWN ISSUES:
==================
None so far! Let me know in the comments section if you run into any issues! Be sure to run your error log through SMAPI's log parser tool as well, otherwise I might not know how to fix the issue. The log parser can be found at SMAPI's official site: [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url]
